name: List All Recurring Charges
description: Returns all recurring charges that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[OccupancyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by occupancy ID. All GET requests must include a filter for [OccupancyId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter recurring charges updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [OccupancyId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the recurring charge

responseFields.name: data[].Amount
responseFields.description: The amount of the recurring charge

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief summary or description of the recurring charge

responseFields.name: data[].Frequency
responseFields.description: The frequency that the recurring charge occurs. Enum: "Monthly" "Every 3 Months" "Every 6 Months" "Once a Year"

responseFields.name: data[].EndDate
responseFields.description: The end date of the recurring charge

responseFields.name: data[].StartDate
responseFields.description: The start date of the recurring charge

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy associated with the recurring charge

responseFields.name: data[].GlAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the general ledger account associated with the recurring charge

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the recurring charge was last updated

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
